No distribution was measured. E's 1.067x capture proxy is 'close to random expectation', nothing stronger.
E IS the registered gauge-control arm — convergent post-hoc evidence from the same arm, never independent. Independence requires a distinct registered source.
No admissible scalar contrast exists in STREAM-WDISTILL-0: arm A serialized 19 bytes over B1. Scalar wording stays descriptive — never 'matched bytes', 'winner', or 'loses'.
